arguments.message:
Hi! To see a detailed breakdown of each line item on an invoice:

1. Go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**.
2. Find the invoice you want and click to open it.
3. Click the **expand** arrow next to any line item. This will show the underlying details – for example, a seat charge will list the number of seats and the per‑seat rate, and an overage line will display the metered quantity versus the plan’s included limit.

Every invoice is divided into three types of line items: seat charges, add‑ons, and usage overages. You can also download the PDF version, which contains the same itemised breakdown.

Let me know if you need any more help!
